A launch bot was also present. Pool depth of 64 SOL means a $20 ticket faces meaningful price impact.

Against the base rates (roughly -20% for a random post-graduation buy, and this coin is down sharply), I find no honest case that real demand will persist for the next 30-60 minutes. Recommendation: skip.
